name: San Jose
limitations: Eight dimensions and 31 subpillars reviewed, not fully measured. Four conditional60 judgments; PCS/GSS/RES/LON unknown. Source-named San Jose FUA includes both documented city reference points, not two slots or complete municipal coverage. Municipal, county, institutional and operator scopes differ. No ranking/exclusion bound or healthy-person lifespan gain; necessary assumptions are withdrawable.

dimensions.rationale: Existing reference-rock seismic evidence and formal emergency plans are partial hazard context, not actual home protection or losses for ordinary residents. Heat/flood/wildfire and current adaptation across the full FUA remain unresolved.
dimensions.assumption: No whole-dimension anchor: plans and monitoring do not prove adequate protection, nor does historical hazard alone establish a current target-resident bottleneck.

dimensions.rationale: Historical organised-violence signals and ordinary security context do not establish a current whole-FUA impact profile. No complete annual local victim/interruption series or regional/strategic review is assembled.
dimensions.assumption: Do not infer low overall impact from missing events or general-crime changes. Actual current impacts, mitigation and broader exposures are needed before selecting an anchor.

dimensions.rationale: Dated restoration of public hospital services supports execution and recovery of a documented service gap. Actual digital-programme withdrawals coexist with remaining public access. Budget pressure and uneven scope/reach remain, without proof of general institutional failure.
dimensions.assumption: Observed execution persists and usually supports major services for ordinary residents across the FUA; reviewed shortfalls do not represent a broader unmitigated bottleneck. Reject continuity, reach or representativeness to restore unknown.

dimensions.rationale: A dated utility report documents completed water works and operational improvements. Utility service and own solar generation do not measure FUA food/energy affordability, independent supply or unmet needs for the median-income citizen.
dimensions.assumption: No whole-dimension anchor: water improvements cannot cancel unmeasured essential-resource burden. Usual affordable supply or an important unresolved target-resident bottleneck needs supported evidence.

dimensions.rationale: Actual restoration of trauma/stroke/cardiac and maternity services, together with scoped nursing/service evidence, supports care pathways. Continued clinical adequacy, routine access, household costs and public/private coverage are not fully measured; recognition is not a population outcome.
dimensions.assumption: Ordinary residents under usual coverage can generally obtain clinically adequate necessary routine/specialist care and afford its costs across the area, with services persisting through the cutoff. Restore unknown if quality, access, affordability, continuity or geographic reach is rejected.

dimensions.rationale: Reviewed Stanford wording describes planned prescribing, while the UCSF page declares availability but contains an obsolete donanemab status. A coauthor affiliation is not a participant location: the reviewed patient study sampled Boston/Utah and the verified biomarker study is Mayo enterprise. Zero published nonfacility address signals do not establish absent adoption.
dimensions.assumption: Credible human/regulatory evidence alone cannot settle local actual delivery, current appropriate monitoring and ordinary access. Neither undated availability, research recruitment nor nonlocal cohorts justify 60; do not infer an actual adoption failure or40 from missing proof.

dimensions.rationale: FY2025 OTL licensing and industry funding support scoped knowledge/industry connections. Dated digital participation coexists with actual hotspot/device-lending closures and remaining Wi-Fi/training. Older charts, institutional receipts and programme availability do not establish current whole-population diffusion.
dimensions.assumption: Observed capabilities persist and support limited industry connections and usable resident diffusion; remaining access channels usually mitigate reviewed constraints for the ordinary target resident across the area. Reject reach, continuity or mitigation to restore unknown; institutional prominence does not justify80.

dimensions.rationale: Actual rail/airport operations connect to shared conditional US-citizen application and account/transfer terms. Public Wi-Fi and service channels remain available despite discontinued lending; no completed relocation/transfer or independent crisis backup is established.
dimensions.assumption: An ordinary resident can generally obtain and afford applicable transport, qualifying residence-purpose approval, an approved compliant account/transfer and usable communications across the FUA through the cutoff. Reject eligibility, affordability, continuity, reach or alternative access to restore unknown.
